hero.title: Three Countries. One Connected Healthcare Journey.
hero.subtitle: Connecting patients from Iraq and the UAE with trusted healthcare providers in India.
hero.description: IBN Sina operates across Iraq, the UAE, and India, helping create a smoother connection between patients and healthcare providers for a seamless medical tourism experience.

overview.title: A Healthcare Journey Without Borders
overview.description: With our presence in Iraq, the UAE, and India, we provide coordinated support throughout every stage of your treatment journey—from your first enquiry to follow-up after treatment.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
